projection.partial_lookup: for role fields and is_alert only: primary root path; if absent only, same path under unmapped.spirithub.partial_fields; explicit null/invalid/conflicting root does not silently fall back
projection.partial_class: class/category/activity remain at original root; never restore target classification to turn class0 into a known class
projection.device_name: display name only; never automatically treated as hostname
projection.invalid_scalar: use legacy typed sentinel or new nullable NULL; preserve original in body; mark partial if a provided mapped value is invalid
projection.missing_optional: empty/NULL is not false, zero activity, no alert, or successful authentication
partial_conditions: missing or invalid required common scalar
projection.unclassified_condition: valid root class_uid=0 without partial conditions; known classes without a tool are still saved
projection.invalid_payload_encoding: invalid_utf8 uses base64 in raw_payload; invalid_json/non_object use exact UTF-8 input; tombstone is empty with tombstone status
projection.ocsf_validation_scope: strict JSON object and defined projection rules only; not a new complete OCSF validation engine
common_structure_checks: class_uid/category_uid/activity_id nonnegative integer literals within UInt32 projection range
type_uid nonnegative integer literal within OCSF long_t range (0..2^63-1); retained in JSON, not projected to UInt32
severity_id integer literal within UInt8 range
time as defined in this contract

identity.source_id_type: non-whitespace string, retain exact text; do not canonicalize opaque IDs
identity.source_id_current_meaning: upstream metadata.uid derives from ingest_id; source record identity only until publisher confirms business update correlation
identity.version: sha256:full-record-v1:<hex>; digest of tagged canonical JSON; invalid payload digest uses raw bytes with a distinct domain
identity.canonical: recursive tagged arrays: object sorted by Unicode code point, array order preserved, string unchanged, boolean distinct, null distinct; integer literals and decimal/exponent literals have separate tags, because strict typed projections distinguish them; within each numeric kind use exact decimal sign/significand/exponent with trailing zeros removed, zero forms become 0e0; strict duplicate-key/nonfinite/surrogate rejection
identity.included: every received JSON field including upstream logging metadata and unknown extensions
identity.excluded: do not add our ingestion clock, Kafka delivery coordinates or projection fields to a source-identified record content digest
identity.uuid: uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, compact UTF-8 JSON array with ensure_ascii=False)
identity.retry_scope: same source ID and same full content are stable across Kafka delivery coordinates; if ID missing, only same original Kafka record stable
identity.update_scope: changed content yields a distinct version; linking several ingestion IDs to one original vendor alert is separate and unconfirmed
identity.transport_change: if upstream rewrites logging metadata, retain new full-record version; no inferred volatile-field stripping
identity.coordinates: row represents one retained delivery; does not create a per-delivery permanent ledger
identity.downstream_alert_ids: unchanged; do not substitute lake UUID for existing RawAlert/material IDs
identity.invalid_payload_version: sha256:raw-bytes-v1:<parse_status>:<hex>; tombstone and empty byte payload are distinct by status

time.accepted: JSON integer literal, not bool, decimal literal or numeric string; Unix epoch milliseconds; no magnitude-based seconds guess
time.iso_strings: not accepted by this bare OCSF1.9 profile; retain original and mark invalid, rather than silently selecting a timezone
time.kafka_time: stored separately; never used as event_time fallback for source-identified records, because a retry may have another Kafka timestamp
time.query: new records use reliable event windows only with event_time_source=ocsf_time_ms; missing/invalid records remain accessible by ingest_time or identity/coordinates; legacy unknown uses explicit old branch
time.semantics: OCSF primary time under its class meaning: activity occurrence for activity classes, finding creation where finding classes redefine it; underlying activity time remains a separate original field

retention.scope: only new mapping versions in explicit profile
retention.ttl_template: if(mapping_version IN (__INGEST_MAPPING_VERSIONS__), toDateTime(ingest_time) + toIntervalDay(__INGEST_RETENTION_DAYS__), toDateTime(event_time) + toIntervalDay(__LEGACY_RETENTION_DAYS__))
retention.purge_rule: new mapping scope uses ingest_time and configured 400-day window; legacy scope keeps existing per-tenant event_time window; DELETE and preview COUNT share exactly one predicate
retention.runtime_purge_worker: not verified in this step; its default disabled/dry-run setting is not evidence of current deployment
retention.no_early_delete: until both TTL and active purge predicates agree, do not start new ingestion under the old event-time deletion rules

delivery.3a: field/mapping/identity/time contract and candidate additive DDL; synthetic rules verified, no database writes
delivery.3b: register append-only migration after current004, synchronize fresh-install DDL and configured TTL/purge predicates; test old/new schema rows in controlled23.8 database
delivery.3d: consumer raw-byte access, configured topic binding and durable per-partition acknowledgement
delivery.3f: source/role/time-aware queries and raw body readback; keep original frozen tool contracts distinguishable
